sloka: रोम कूपेषु सर्वेषु वसिष्ठस्य महात्मनः ।मरीच्य इव निष्पेतुः अग्नेः धूम आकुल अर्चिषः ॥१-५६-१८॥
transliteration: roma kūpeṣu sarveṣu vasiṣṭhasya mahātmanaḥ ।marīcya iva niṣpetuḥ agneḥ dhūma ākula arciṣaḥ ॥1-56-18॥

translations.english: From every pore of the great Vasishta's body flames resembling rays of light with smoke emerged.
